# Himalayan Odyssey Expedition

> A local tour operator in Narkanda, Himachal Pradesh, India, offering Spiti Valley, Winter Spiti, Kinnaur and customised Himalayan group and private trips.

Based in Narkanda, Himachal Pradesh 172029, India. Phone and WhatsApp: +91 98169 29669. Services include transport, mountain stays and local ground handling for travel agencies. Confirm current routes, road conditions, availability, inclusions and prices directly before booking. Snowfall and road access are not guaranteed.

## Official business information

- [Official website](https://himalayanexpedition.co.in/): Tour packages, upcoming departures and travel enquiries.
- [About us and contact](https://himalayanexpedition.co.in/about-us/): Business identity and official contact details.
- [Himachal B2B tour operator](https://himalayanexpedition.co.in/himachal-b2b-tour-operator/): Local transport, stays and ground coordination for travel agencies.

## Tour packages

- [Spiti Valley tours](https://himalayanexpedition.co.in/spiti-valley-tours/): Group and private tour options.
- [Winter Spiti tours](https://himalayanexpedition.co.in/winter-spiti-tours/): Winter route planning and departures.
- [Spiti tours from Chandigarh](https://himalayanexpedition.co.in/spiti-tour-from-chandigarh/): Pickup and itinerary planning.
- [Kinnaur tours](https://himalayanexpedition.co.in/kinnaur-tours/): Sangla, Chitkul and Kalpa journeys.
- [Narkanda tours](https://himalayanexpedition.co.in/narkanda-tours/): Local mountain experiences and stays.
